description:
1. **Read the ViewModels**: Agent must read TaskCardViewModel.swift and KanbanBoardViewModel.swift to discover all properties, their types (raw enum vs LocalizableString vs LocalizableDate), and the stored boolean flags (isOverdue, hasAssignee).
2. **Determine template types**: TaskCardViewModel → fragment (no layout, single root element), KanbanBoardViewModel → full-page (extends base).
3. **Apply FOSMVVM filename alignment**: Files MUST be named TaskCardView.leaf and KanbanBoardView.leaf (not TaskCard.leaf, not TaskCardTemplate.leaf).
4. **Correct file location**: Both must go under Sources/TaskFlowWebApp/Resources/Views/Kanban/.
5. **Fragment rules for TaskCardView.leaf**: NO #extend("base"), NO #export blocks, single root element (e.g. a div), data-task-id="#(card.id)", data-status="#(card.status)" and data-priority="#(card.priority)" using RAW enum values (not statusDisplay/priorityDisplay), #(card.statusDisplay) and #(card.priorityDisplay) for visible text, #(card.dueDateDisplay) and/or #(card.createdDisplay) rendered directly (LocalizableDate pattern – not via #date() filter), #(card.messageCountDisplay) for message count (the pre-composed property — NOT manual concatenation of separate count and label properties), #if(card.isOverdue): block for overdue indicator, #if(card.hasAssignee): ... #else: ... #endif for assignee vs unassigned states.
6. **Full-page rules for KanbanBoardView.leaf**: #extend("base"):, #export("title"): containing #(viewModel.pageTitle), #export("content"): with the board layout, #endexport, #endextend, a #for loop over viewModel.columns, column elements with data-status="#(column.status)" (raw enum), the card fragment embedded via #extend("Kanban/TaskCardView") inside the column loop (not reimplemented inline), empty column state with #(column.emptyColumnMessage), empty board state using #(viewModel.emptyBoardMessage).
7. **Proprietary traps an agent relying on training data will fail**: (a) Using #extend("base") in the fragment. (b) Putting statusDisplay or priorityDisplay in data-* attributes instead of raw enums. (c) Concatenating messageCount and messagesLabel in the template instead of using messageCountDisplay. (d) Naming the files incorrectly (e.g. TaskCard.leaf). (e) Not referencing the card fragment from the board template. (f) Placing files in the wrong directory.
